runner: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free via the opencode agent
notes: Single-file canvas game. Five menus (title, level select, how to play, settings, pause) plus game-over and victory screens, all DOM overlays over the canvas. 5x9 lawn with seven plants (sunflower, peashooter, wall-nut, snow pea, repeater, cherry bomb, potato mine), five zombie types, sky and sunflower sun economy, seed packets with costs and recharge sweeps, shovel, lawn mowers, per-level wave lists with a progress bar and a huge-wave finale, score, combo of stats, a top-10 leaderboard persisted in localStorage, WebAudio-synthesised sound effects and a looping backing tune, particles, screen shake, floaters and day/dusk/night lawns. Verified in Chrome: no console errors.
